title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Termination Fee Schedule by Months Remaining
content:
# Termination Fee by Months Remaining — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, Closed-End Units

**Schedule.** For a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease ended before its scheduled end date by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the termination fee follows the whole months remaining from the turn-in date to the scheduled end date: where 6 or fewer months remain, the termination fee is half (0.5) of the closed-end early termination fee for the tier; where 7 to 11 months remain, it is the closed-end early termination fee for the tier multiplied by the months remaining and divided by 12; where 12 or more months remain, it is the closed-end early termination fee for the tier.

**Counting.** The turn-in date is the date the unit was turned in or recovered, as the unit records it. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later one and are one fewer where the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

## Schedule table

| Whole months remaining, turn-in date to scheduled end date | Termination fee |
|---|---|
| 0 to 6 | one half of the tier's closed-end early termination fee |
| 7 to 11 | the tier's closed-end early termination fee multiplied by the months remaining, divided by 12 |
| 12 or more | the tier's closed-end early termination fee |

## Counting the months (hypothetical dates)

| Turn-in date | Scheduled end date | Whole months remaining |
|---|---|---|
| the 15th of a month | the 15th of the seventh month after | 7 |
| the 15th of a month | the 14th of the seventh month after | 6 (the later day, 14, is smaller than 15) |
| the 10th of a month | the 10th of the twelfth month after | 12 |
| the 10th of a month | the 9th of the twelfth month after | 11 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier fee of 720)

| Whole months remaining | Termination fee |
|---|---|
| 6 | one half of 720: 360 |
| 7 | 720 multiplied by 7, divided by 12: 420 |
| 9 | 720 multiplied by 9, divided by 12: 540 |
| 11 | 720 multiplied by 11, divided by 12: 660 |
| 12 | 720 |

Both sides of each threshold: 6 months gives one half of the fee and 7 months gives seven twelfths; 11 months gives eleven twelfths and 12 months gives the whole fee.
